name: The Circle Closes
map_hint: Three coaches. One file. Bring the kit you finished. The Archive already knows the top of your deck.

nodes.title: Three Coaches
nodes.blurb: Ops, the Chaplain, and the Voice in one room. They hate this.

story_panels.text: Ops has a room that is not on any floor plan. The Chaplain is already standing. The Voice is a hiss in the vent. None of them look at each other.
"You closed three wings," Ops says. "Congratulations. The file still has a hole." The Chaplain: "This is pride." The Voice: "This is molt." They agree on nothing except you.
A Network cell is in the hall. After that, one card from each pile. Then the Archive itself — thirty life, silent, the top of your deck face-up. Live.

nodes.title: Hired Guns
nodes.blurb: Mixed Network list. No teach. AI at 16 life. This is a test.

dialogue.speaker: Ops
dialogue.text: Freelancers. Anyone can hire them. Do not teach them your kit.

nodes.title: Three Piles
nodes.blurb: One card from each faction's field pool.

safehouse.text: Three envelopes on the table. Lodge, Faith, Comb. Take one. The Archive does not care which pile you insult.

pick_one_of.label: Lodge pile
pick_one_of.blurb: Puppet Master. Take control of a small body. One spare card is cut to stay at 30.

pick_one_of.label: Faith pile
pick_one_of.blurb: Warden of Secrets. Taunt that draws on death. One spare card is cut to stay at 30.

pick_one_of.label: Comb pile
pick_one_of.blurb: Apex Stalker. Stealth. Enraged. One spare card is cut to stay at 30.

dialogue.speaker: The Archive
dialogue.text: Choose. The file will remember the envelope you opened.

nodes.title: The Archive
nodes.blurb: Thirty life. Silent. Black Room — your top card is face-up. No teach.

twist.label: Black Room
twist.description: The top card of your deck is face-up. The Archive already knows what you draw.

story_panels_on_enter.text: The door does not open. It was never closed. A phosphor lamp over a steel table. Your deck is already face-up on it.
No coach on the radio. Thirty life. The file has been waiting since City.

nodes.lesson_win: The Circle closes. ARCHIVE_WALKER is on file. The spine is quiet.
nodes.lesson_loss: The top card is not a secret. Play what it gives you. Thirty life is a stall, not a race.

file_three_coaches.title: File: Three Coaches
file_three_coaches.text: Ops called the meeting. The Chaplain brought a lamp. The Voice came as a hiss. They still do not like each other.

file_hired.title: File: Hired Guns
file_hired.text: The Network works for whoever pays. Tonight they worked for the hole in the file.

file_three_piles.title: File: Three Piles
file_three_piles.text: Lodge, Faith, Comb. One envelope. The Archive logged the choice.

file_archive.title: File: The Archive
file_archive.text: Thirty life. Top card face-up. No coach. The file does not negotiate.

file_circle_closed.title: File: The Circle Closes
file_circle_closed.text: City, Vault, Hive, Crypt, Nest. Then this room. ARCHIVE_WALKER is the name the file kept.
